verdict.rationale: Entra documents SCIM-based automatic provisioning of users into SaaS apps like Dropbox, Salesforce and ServiceNow, and into on-prem apps. Lifecycle Workflows run automated processes against users across the joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle, which implies an orchestrated offboarding path. Missing for 10: any evidence that deactivating a user revokes or kills active sessions/tokens, evidence that deprovisioning across apps happens immediately rather than on a sync cycle, explicit documentation of a single-action leaver flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
